items.title: AI infrastructure stocks surge after strong earnings from CoreWeave, Supermicro
items.summary: AI infrastructure stocks jumped, with shares of AI server makers, optical-products companies, and neocloud providers moving higher.

items.title: Big Cash, Bigger Ambitions: POET Technologies Eyes 147% Upside
items.summary: POET Technologies carries a fortress balance sheet, a landmark customer contract, and a Malaysia production ramp finally moving toward real shipments, yet lawsuits, massive dilution, and a sky-high valuation make this one of the most polarizing AI photonics bets on the Nasdaq right now.

items.title: Nebius, CoreWeave, Super Micro, Palantir, SpaceX, Quantinuum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Nebius soars as the so-called neocloud reports better-than-expected second-quarter results, while fellow neocloud company CoreWeave posts a narrower quarterly loss, sending the stock up sharply.

items.title: Lumentum Stock Jumps as Stellar Earnings Extend Blazing-Hot Run
items.summary: The optical networking company reports better-than-expected earnings and revenue for its fiscal fourth quarter.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Wednesday: CoreWeave, Super Micro, Cisco
items.summary: ↗️ CoreWeave (CRWV): Shares jumped over 20% in morning trading after the cloud-computing company posted its fifth straight quarter of record revenue, fueled by sustained AI demand. ↗️ Super Micro Computer (SMCI): Shares rose above 15% at the open after the company reported a surging profit and sales nearly doubling in its fourth quarter.
